name: talos-platform-base-release-tooling
description: npm toolchain pins ONLY (semantic-release + conventionalcommits preset for releases; openspec + markdownlint-cli for the docs/spec gates). This repo is NOT a Node project; this manifest exists solely to pin the npm-distributed tools reproducibly with lockfile integrity hashes. It is excluded from the OCI artifact (see .ci-oci-tarball-include.txt) and installed via `npm ci --ignore-scripts` (CI and `task *:install-cli`). See knowledge/workflows/release-process.md and knowledge/workflows/spec-driven-development.md.
